objective: Establish parallel, isolated validation of the general Astronomical Data Analysis & Discovery Platform beyond the CPVS historical reconstruction claim.
previous_knowledge_consumed: README and canonical handbook define ZTF Classifier as an Astronomical Data Analysis & Discovery Platform.
Issue #170 and the current CPVS audit preserve the 11,602 candidate-only discrepancy as unresolved.
The frozen v0.2.0 scientific baseline includes 42 features and must remain immutable.
The product roadmap already distinguishes product-level scientific validation from claim-specific historical reproduction.

Read-only source inspection shows local CSV/Parquet ingestion is generic, but NativeV0_2Backend uses the frozen 42-feature schema and the source-backed executor is observation-service/model-registry based.

baseline.status: v1.0.1 immutable software release; v0.2.0 immutable scientific baseline; CPVS exact membership unresolved; independent dataset and second-paper runs not yet verified.

expected_improvement: Separate generic data ingestion from dataset/model-specific scientific interpretation.
Obtain known-answer evidence on an independent astronomical dataset and a deterministic 50-object diagnostic sample.
Exercise 50 input/schema/quality cases and record both success and failure outcomes.
Review a second scientific method independently of CPVS.
Build an evidence-backed GitHub ecosystem gap matrix with license and compatibility review.
Keep the CPVS discrepancy isolated from generic product rules and preserve all scientific gates.

correctness.before: No verified independent-dataset or deterministic 50-case result is recorded in this stage.
correctness.after: Plan and tracking issue recorded; execution evidence remains pending.

reproducibility.before: The parallel test sequence and evidence requirements were not yet consolidated in a current canonical plan.
reproducibility.after: Canonical plan defines isolation, manifests, hashes, known-answer checks, acceptance criteria, and workstream ownership.

scientific_validity.before: CPVS exact reconstruction remains unresolved and cannot serve as the sole test of general product validity.
scientific_validity.after: Independent dataset, second-method, and general-input validation are explicitly separated from CPVS; their results remain NOT YET VERIFIED.

evidence: Created canonical plan at docs/roadmap/PARALLEL_VALIDATION_AND_ECOSYSTEM_PLAN_2026-10-22.md on an isolated documentation branch.
Updated README, handbook, product roadmap, scientific-validation roadmap, ecosystem review, and architectural decisions on that branch.
Created tracking Issue #210 and draft documentation PR #211; neither is merged.
Read-only inspection of application/ingestion.py confirms CSV/Parquet import, schema checks, and SHA-256 provenance.
Read-only inspection of features/engine.py confirms the native backend preserves the frozen v0.2 42-feature schema.
Read-only inspection of jobs/executor.py and docs/api/API_V1.md confirms current end-to-end object analysis is not a generic arbitrary-feature analysis path.
No independent dataset was executed; no 50-object sample or 50-case matrix has been run; no second-paper replication is claimed complete.
No scientific code, model, data, or release artifact was changed.

Follow-up source inspection verified that StarEmbed acquisition is implemented, but the benchmark runner requires a prepared sourceid/class_str/y_pred prediction table and does not generate predictions from raw StarEmbed light curves.
Current heavy scientific-validation workflow acquires StarEmbed and then downloads large CPVS g/r archives; no StarEmbed raw-light-curve-to-model inference step was found.

root_causes: A generic table importer is not equivalent to a general-purpose scientific analysis engine.
The default feature backend and production model intentionally bind to a frozen schema; cross-dataset analysis requires explicit adapters/versioned feature schemas and validation.
Prior work was too centered on CPVS reconstruction to provide sufficient independent evidence of general product capability; the new plan creates separate workstreams.

The registered external benchmark acquisition/evaluation contracts are not yet connected to a raw-dataset inference path for StarEmbed; an existing benchmark evaluator is not itself a general scientific analysis engine.

findings: CPVS is a claim-specific historical benchmark, not the definition of the product.
Dataset-specific selection and feature rules must not become universal ingestion requirements.
A deterministic 50-object sample is diagnostic unless a stronger statistical design justifies population-level claims.
Generic CSV/Parquet ingestion is currently supported, but arbitrary-feature analysis is not established by that fact.
Passing CI validates only executed contracts and does not independently establish astrophysical validity or broad dataset generality.
The frozen v0.2.0 baseline and fail-closed scientific gates remain unchanged.
StarEmbed source acquisition is not end-to-end validation: raw-data inference and prediction-table generation are a separate missing step.

open_blockers: Run and inspect CI, CodeQL, Product Scope Audit, and Scientific Validation for draft PR #211 before merge.
Complete full source audit of ingestion, normalization, feature engine, analysis modes, output schemas, and provenance.
Select and hash-record an independent public astronomy dataset and execute a deterministic 50-object sample.
Execute and report the 50-case input/schema/quality matrix.
Select a second paper/method and establish a source-backed replication protocol.
Inspect candidate GitHub repositories, licenses, tests, and implementation details; produce a prioritized gap matrix.
Continue CPVS Issue #170 independently; explain or source-document the 11,602 candidate-only objects.

Implement a versioned, schema-aware StarEmbed prediction-generation path after inspecting source schema/units and preserving split/OOD boundaries; emit provenance-backed predictions for the existing evaluator.
Split StarEmbed acquisition/evaluation from the heavy CPVS archive workflow to avoid unnecessary data transfer/runtime.

knowledge_carried_forward: Parallel validation and ecosystem comparison are adopted as five isolated workstreams under Issue #210.
Draft PR #211 records documentation changes but is not merged and is not a completed validation result.
The native feature/model path remains schema-specific; arbitrary-feature analysis must not be claimed until implemented and tested.
CPVS exact reconstruction remains unresolved; the frozen v0.2.0 baseline remains immutable.
As of 2026-10-23, StarEmbed end-to-end evaluation is BLOCKED because the existing runner scores prepared predictions rather than producing them from raw light curves.
